packages.name: Quick Part Import
packages.description: Search JLC/LCSC parts and add them in one click, or drag & drop part ZIPs from Component Search Engine, SnapMagic, UltraLibrarian or Octopart, into a library that lives inside your project
packages.description_full:
Adds a part window to the schematic and PCB editor.

Search: type a part number, pick a JLC/LCSC result and click Add - symbol, footprint and STEP model are downloaded, converted by KiCad itself and added, with the LCSC Part # field set for JLC assembly. Component Search Engine and SnapMagic results open in your browser; the ZIP you download there is imported automatically.

Drop: drop the ZIP you downloaded from Component Search Engine (SamacSys), SnapMagic (SnapEDA), UltraLibrarian or Octopart.

Everything lands in one library inside the project folder (lib/<Project>.kicad_sym, .pretty and .3dshapes), registered in the project's library tables with ${KIPRJMOD} paths. Symbols are linked to their footprints and footprints to their 3D models. Importing a part again updates it without duplicates and a failed import never changes anything.

Needs the KiCad API: Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API.
